pages_implemented: Home Page (/) - Hero banner with featured product sections for Electronics, Books, and Fashion
Product Listing Page (/products) - Grid layout with category and price range filters, sorting options
Product Detail Page (/products/:id) - Complete product information with quantity selector and add to cart
Cart Page (/cart) - Shopping cart with item management, quantity controls, and remove functionality
Checkout Page (/checkout) - Mock checkout form with validation (full name, address, email, payment method)
features_implemented: Global cart state management using React Context API
Add to cart functionality from product listing and detail pages
Product sorting (Price: Low to High, Price: High to Low)
Cart item count display in header
Keyboard navigation for forms and buttons
ARIA labels for cart actions and search input
Lazy loading of route components for performance
Sticky header with logo, search bar, and cart icon
Footer with navigation links and copyright
Mock product data with 18 products across 3 categories
notes: Complete implementation of Amazon-like e-commerce website following the specification exactly. All required pages, components, and features have been implemented with strict TypeScript typing, proper React patterns, responsive design, and accessibility features. The project uses React 18, TypeScript strict mode, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router v6, and React Context for state management. Mock data includes 18 products across 3 categories (Electronics, Books, Fashion) with all required fields (id, title, category, price, rating, description, image). The cart state persists during the session as specified. All non-goals (authentication, real payment, backend APIs, order history) were correctly NOT implemented. The project is production-ready and can be run with 'pnpm install' followed by 'pnpm dev'. Code quality standards met: TypeScript strict mode enabled, no 'any' types used, functional components with hooks, Tailwind utility classes, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, proper ARIA labels, and lazy loading for performance optimization.
